subject: CTE Admissions Lottery and Bus Monitoring Plan
overview: The School Committee approved a new lottery-based admissions policy for vocational programs and reviewed a tiered plan to implement bus monitors using internal staff. The committee also formalized student representation on its regular agenda and discussed multi-year grant funding for student civic projects.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee convened to discuss collective bargaining and an administrator grievance with Teamsters Local 25.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved various bills, payrolls, and donations, including a $10,000 scholarship for the track team in memory of Michael Mobilia.

items.title: Mustang Moment: CTE Student Presentations
items.summary: Four vocational students shared their experiences in the health assisting, electrical, cosmetology, and exploratory programs.

items.title: CTE Admissions Policy and Program Expansion
items.summary: Approved a first and second reading of the Chapter 74 Program Admissions Policy, which implements a non-weighted lottery for program placement when demand exceeds capacity. The director announced that a new plumbing program will open sooner than anticipated to meet student interest.

items.title: CCSR Update and Budget Approval
items.summary: Approved the $35,000 projected budget for the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility, which is supported by a ten-year grant from the Cummings Foundation.

items.title: Bus Monitor Implementation Report
items.summary: Reviewed a proposal to address bus safety and overcrowding through a tiered monitoring system using rotating paraprofessional schedules and stipends. The district has hired a new transportation manager to oversee operations starting in mid-October.

items.title: High School Design Presentation Invitation
items.summary: Approved a resolution to invite the incoming City Council members to attend the feasibility study presentation by the high school design firm.

items.title: Student Representation on School Committee
items.summary: Approved a resolution formalizing student council presentations on the committee agenda and establishing a rotation for members to observe monthly student council meetings.
